trigger: Mandate S7: re-examine partial/failed classifications. Four defects found in live state: (a) FT-Transformer + InteractionNet rich-view attempts FAILED on CUDA OOM at INNER-VAL/EVAL inference (unchunked 55971-row val forward and 65536-row eval chunks on 285 tokens / 40330 pair-terms) -- a RESOURCE limit, not an architectural negative; (b) DCNv2 cross layer is SCALAR (Linear(n_features,1) -> rank-1 W = 1*w^T), NOT canonical DCNv2 (full W) or DCNv2-low-rank (u v^T) -- its negative cannot close canonical DCNv2; (c) item 64 Approx RBF SVM was closed by the classical-block addendum WITHOUT ever being run (only oblique + kernelridge results exist); (d) item 65 Factorized logistic interactions was closed by the additive-logreg negative -- a different model. (e) Items 35/36 (MTL) carry F1 but have full fold-0 numbers = F2; item 60/63 carry F1 but were measured = F2 with proxy labels.
resolution: Run the four missing/incorrectly-classified measurements with declared resource adaptations; reclassify catalogue rows accordingly; no claim about canonical DCNv2 or RFF-SVM or factorized-logistic until measured.
view: full (certified 285-feature rich view, fold-safe TE via ViewBuilder.assemble) for all repairs; route secondary only where stated.
fold: primary_5f_seed20261010; fold-0 discovery screen (F2; cannot pass admission gate)
train: all FIT rows (folds 1-4 = 559708); inner 10% ES split fold-safe (seed 1); scaler fit on FIT-train only

fttransformer_full_bounded.change: RESOURCE ADAPTATION ONLY (math identical): train batch_size 4096 -> 1024 (attention memory scales with batch x tokens^2; 4096x8x286x286 bf16 x 3 layers cannot fit 16 GB), inner-val + eval inference chunked at 4096 rows (row-independent batching; numerics per row unchanged).
fttransformer_full_bounded.arch: unchanged frozen FT-Transformer: d_token 192, n_layers 3, n_heads 8, dropout 0.1, head_hidden 192
fttransformer_full_bounded.interpretation: measures the SAME architecture on the rich view; prior rich-view FAILED status was resource-limited

interactionnet_full_bounded.change: RESOURCE ADAPTATION ONLY: inner-val + eval inference chunked at 4096 rows (40330 pair-terms x 55971 val rows x fp32 was the 8.44 GiB allocation). train batch 4096 unchanged (4096x40330 bf16 = 660 MB, fits).
interactionnet_full_bounded.arch: unchanged: upper-triangular pairwise products -> MLP d_hidden 256, n_layers 2, dropout 0.1

dcnv2full.change: NEW ARCHITECTURE: canonical DCNv2 cross layer x_{l+1} = x_0 ⊙ (W_l x_l + b_l) + x_l with FULL W_l in R^{n_feat x n_feat} (n_feat<=512 so dense is cheap), replacing the scalar-cross proxy (W = 1*w^T). Deep MLP branch + concat head unchanged from the proxy so the ONLY delta is the cross matrix rank.
dcnv2full.interpretation: if dcnv2full ALSO lands at port_delta < +5e-5, the cross-network family is closed for canonical W too; if it differs materially, the proxy measurement was the defect

factlog.change: Factorized (bilinear) logistic: logit = w.x + sum_{r=1..16} (u_r.x)(v_r.x), rank-16 low-rank interaction logistic trained end-to-end (Adam, BCE, inner-val ES). This is the interaction model item 65 asked for; the additive logreg that closed it is a different hypothesis.

rffsvm.change: Approximate RBF SVM via random Fourier features: RBFSampler(n_components=512, gamma=0.01, random_state=1) -> LinearSVC(C=1.0). score = decision_function (monotone-valid for AUC, same convention as the kernelridge precedent). StandardScaler fit on FIT-train only.
rffsvm.note: gamma=0.01 fixed (median heuristic on 285 standardized features lands near 1/n_feat ~ 0.0035; 0.01 is the preregistered constant -- no tuning to any board)

negative_rule: each repair records NEGATIVE for its exact frozen recipe if portfolio_delta < +5e-5 or corr >= 0.995; no rerun of an identical fingerprint; the four prior proxy/failed rows keep their ledger history (append-only) and get reclassified, never deleted
anti_leakage: view fold-safe (TE fit on FIT, EVAL labels never read); all training data subsets of FIT; inner ES from FIT only; champion hash-asserted via load_champion_fold0; no public-LB contact
